decisions.reason: Having remained on the market after launch and fitting directly into the firm's secure enterprise messaging platform, the inbound SMS API is likely to be retained as a complementary building block of its broader cloud communication offer.

The email-to-SMS gateway is close to the firm's core business, supports integrated multichannel communication for enterprise workflows, and is therefore likely to be kept unless adoption proves weaker than expected.

The SMS-to-email gateway extends the same established communication suite with a low-distance, complementary function, so a large incumbent provider would usually keep it on the market while building out the platform.
